description_en: Retrieves the details of Data Integration real-time synchronization tasks and synchronization solutions
description_zh: 获取数据集成实时同步任务和同步解决方案的详情
name: GetDISyncTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for the current API invoke operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Data Integration synchronization task associated with the destination data source. Valid values:

DI_REALTIME: Data Integration real-time synchronization node
DI_SOLUTION: Data Integration synchronization solution
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所关联的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。取值如下：

DI_REALTIME：表示数据集成实时同步任务。
DI_SOLUTION：表示数据集成同步解决方案
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
If TaskType is set to DI_REALTIME, FileId is the file ID of the real-time synchronization task.
If TaskType is set to DI_SOLUTION, FileId is the task ID of the synchronization solution.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh:
当TaskType为DI_REALTIME时，则FileId为实时同步任务的文件ID。
当TaskType为DI_SOLUTION时，则FileId为同步解决方案的任务ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

schema.description_en: The return result of the Data Integration task
schema.description_zh: 获取数据集成任务的返回结果

Data.description_en: The return result of the Data Integration task
Data.description_zh: 获取数据集成任务的返回结果

AlarmList.description_en: The array of alert rules associated with the real-time task
AlarmList.description_zh: 实时任务相关联的报警规则数组

items.description_en: An alert rule associated with the real-time task
items.description_zh: 单条实时任务相关联的报警规则

AlarmRuleList.description_en: The array of alert notification configurations

Aggregator.description_en:
The calculation method for the metric. Valid values:

avg: average value in the interval
max: maximum value in the interval
Aggregator.description_zh:
指标的计算方法：
avg 区间取平均
max 区间取最大值

Comparator.description_en:
The comparison operator, which specifies the comparison method between the metric and the alert rule. Valid values:

'='
'<'
'>'
Comparator.description_zh:
比较符号，指标和告警规则的比较方法：
'=' 
'<'
'>'

Duration.description_en: The duration. An alert is triggered only when the condition is met for the specified duration. Unit: minutes
Duration.description_zh: 持续时间，满足该条件持续多久才会触发报警，单位分钟

Level.description_en:
The alert level. Valid values:

WARNING: warning alert
CRITICAL: critical alert
Level.description_zh:
WARNING  警告告警
CRITICAL 严重告警

Threshold.description_en: The comparison threshold between the metric and the alert rule
Threshold.description_zh: 指标和告警规则的比较阈值

Description.description_en: The description of the alert rule

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the alert rule is enabled

Id.description_en: The ID of the alert rule

Metric.description_en:
The alert type. Valid values:

taskStatus: task status
bizDelay: business latency
taskFailoverCount: failover monitoring
ddlUnsupport: unsupported DDL
ddlReport: DDL notification
totalDirtyRecordWriteInLines: dirty data
Metric.description_zh:
报警类型：

taskStatus 任务状态
bizDelay 业务延迟
taskFailoverCount 监控Failover
ddlUnsupport DDL不支持
ddlReport DDL通知
totalDirtyRecordWriteInLines 脏数据

NotifyRule.description_en: The array of alert notification rules

Critical.description_en: The list of critical-level alert notifications

items.description_en:
The notification channel. Valid values:

Mail: email
Phone: phone call
Sms: text message
Ding: DingTalk
items.description_zh:
通道，可选的枚举值：

Mail（邮件）
Phone（电话）
Sms（短信）
Ding（钉钉）

Warning.description_en: The list of warning-level alert notifications

RuleName.description_en: The name of the alert rule

Code.description_en:
If TaskType is set to DI_REALTIME, the details of the real-time synchronization task are returned.
If TaskType is set to DI_SOLUTION, the value is null
Code.description_zh:
如果TaskType为DI_REALTIME，则获取实时同步任务的详情。
如果TaskType为DI_SOLUTION，则为null

Message.description_en:
The cause of the failure to retrieve the Data Integration synchronization task.

If the Data Integration synchronization task is successfully retrieved, this parameter is empty
Message.description_zh:
获取数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。

如果获取数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

SolutionDetail.description_en:
If TaskType is set to DI_REALTIME, the value is null.
If TaskType is set to DI_SOLUTION, the details of the synchronization solution task are returned
SolutionDetail.description_zh:
如果TaskType为DI_REALTIME，则为null。
如果TaskType为DI_SOLUTION，则获取同步解决方案任务的详情

CreatorName.description_en: The name of the creator of the synchronization solution task
CreatorName.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务的创建者名称

Id.description_en: The task ID of the synchronization solution

Name.description_en: The name of the synchronization solution task
Name.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务的名称

ProcessContent.description_en: The configuration details of the synchronization solution
ProcessContent.description_zh: 同步解决方案的配置详情

ProcessExtra.description_en: The additional parameters of the synchronization solution task
ProcessExtra.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务的额外参数

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the project to which the synchronization solution task belongs
ProjectId.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务所在的项目ID

SourceType.description_en: The type of the source for the synchronization solution task
SourceType.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务源端的类型

StartTime.description_en:
The start time of the synchronization solution task.

The time is in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format, such as `2021-12-07 14:40:51`
StartTime.description_zh:
同步解决方案任务的开始时间。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2021-12-07 14:40:51`

Status.description_en:
The execution status of the synchronization solution. Valid values:

0: successful 
1: not running 
2: running
3: failed 
4: commit
5: pending manual confirmation
6: manual confirmation completed
7: other 
8: waiting 
9: deleted
Status.description_zh:
同步解决方案的执行状态

0-成功 
1-未运行 
2-运行中
3-失败 
4-提交
5-待人工确认
6-人工确认完成
7-其他 
8-等待 
9-已删除

SubmitTime.description_en:
The time when the synchronization solution task was submitted.

The time is in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format, such as `2021-12-07 14:40:51`
SubmitTime.description_zh:
同步解决方案任务提交的时间。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2021-12-07 14:40:51`

Type.description_en: The type of the synchronization solution task
Type.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务的类型

Status.description_en:
The result status of retrieving the Data Integration synchronization task. Valid values:

Success: The Data Integration synchronization task is successfully retrieved.
Fail: The Data Integration synchronization task fails to be retrieved
Status.description_zh:
获取数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：

Success：表示获取数据集成同步任务成功。
Fail：表示获取数据集成同步任务失败

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

False: failed
